mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.title, e.course_role AS role, c.term_start_date AS termStartDate, c.term_end_date AS termEndDate FROM enrollment e INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.active = 1 AND e.course_role = 'Instructor' AND c.state <> 'Archived' ORDER BY c.course_code ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT 'AssignmentUngraded' AS kind, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, a.title, COUNT(*) AS pendingCount, MIN(v.submitted_at) AS oldestWaitingAt, a.id AS assignmentId, NULL AS quizId FROM assignment a INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id INNER JOIN assignment_submission s ON s.assignment_id = a.id AND s.current_version_id IS NOT NULL AND s.group_id IS NULL INNER JOIN assignment_submission_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id LEFT JOIN assignment_grade g ON g.assignment_id = a.id AND g.student_user_id = s.owner_user_id WHERE a.course_id IN #{id} AND a.submission_type = 'Individual' AND g.id IS NULL GROUP BY a.id, a.course_id, c.course_code, a.title HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT 'AssignmentUngraded' AS kind, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, a.title, COUNT(*) AS pendingCount, MIN(v.submitted_at) AS oldestWaitingAt, a.id AS assignmentId, NULL AS quizId FROM assignment a INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id INNER JOIN assignment_submission s ON s.assignment_id = a.id AND s.current_version_id IS NOT NULL AND s.group_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN assignment_submission_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id LEFT JOIN assignment_grade g ON g.assignment_id = a.id AND g.group_id = s.group_id WHERE a.course_id IN #{id} AND a.submission_type = 'Group' AND g.id IS NULL GROUP BY a.id, a.course_id, c.course_code, a.title HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT 'AssignmentAwaitingRelease' AS kind, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, a.title, COUNT(*) AS pendingCount, MIN(g.entered_at) AS oldestWaitingAt, a.id AS assignmentId, NULL AS quizId FROM assignment_grade g INNER JOIN assignment a ON a.id = g.assignment_id INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE a.course_id IN #{id} AND g.status = 'Entered' GROUP BY a.id, a.course_id, c.course_code, a.title HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT 'QuizManualPending' AS kind, q.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, q.title, COUNT(*) AS pendingCount, MIN(att.submitted_at) AS oldestWaitingAt, NULL AS assignmentId, q.id AS quizId FROM quiz_attempt_answer ans INNER JOIN quiz_attempt att ON att.id = ans.attempt_id AND att.status = 'Submitted' INNER JOIN quiz q ON q.id = att.quiz_id INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = q.course_id WHERE q.course_id IN #{id} AND ans.pending_manual = 1 GROUP BY q.id, q.course_id, c.course_code, q.title HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT 'QuizAwaitingRelease' AS kind, q.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, q.title, COUNT(*) AS pendingCount, MIN(g.created_at) AS oldestWaitingAt, NULL AS assignmentId, q.id AS quizId FROM quiz_grade g INNER JOIN quiz q ON q.id = g.quiz_id INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = q.course_id WHERE q.course_id IN #{id} AND g.status = 'Entered' GROUP BY q.id, q.course_id, c.course_code, q.title HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT s.id, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, s.type, s.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.location, c.term_start_date AS termStartDate, c.term_end_date AS termEndDate FROM course_session s INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id WHERE s.course_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.course_id, s.id

SELECT e.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, 'CourseEvent' AS type, e.name AS title, e.event_date AS `date`, e.start_time AS startTime, e.end_time AS endTime, e.location, 'Event' AS source, e.id AS sourceId FROM course_event e INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.course_id IN #{id} AND e.event_date >= #{fromDate} AND e.event_date <= #{toDate} ORDER BY e.event_date ASC, e.start_time ASC, e.id ASC

SELECT 'Assignment' AS kind, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, a.title, a.due_at AS atUtc, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.user_id) FROM enrollment e2 WHERE e2.course_id = a.course_id AND e2.active = 1 AND e2.course_role = 'Student' AND e2.assignment_submit_frozen = 0 AND ( (a.submission_type = 'Individual' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assignment_submission s WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id AND s.owner_user_id = e2.user_id AND s.current_version_id IS NOT NULL AND s.group_id IS NULL )) OR (a.submission_type = 'Group' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_membership gm INNER JOIN assignment_submission s ON s.group_id = gm.group_id AND s.current_version_id IS NOT NULL WHERE gm.user_id = e2.user_id AND gm.group_set_id = a.group_set_id AND s.assignment_id = a.id )) ) ) AS submittedCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment e3 WHERE e3.course_id = a.course_id AND e3.active = 1 AND e3.course_role = 'Student' AND e3.assignment_submit_frozen = 0 ) AS totalStudents, a.id AS assignmentId, NULL AS quizId FROM assignment a INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE a.course_id IN #{id} AND a.state = 'Published' AND a.due_at >= #{fromUtc} AND a.due_at <= #{toUtc} ORDER BY a.due_at ASC, a.id ASC

SELECT 'Quiz' AS kind, q.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, q.title, q.closes_at AS atUtc, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.user_id) FROM enrollment e2 INNER JOIN quiz_attempt att ON att.user_id = e2.user_id AND att.status = 'Submitted' WHERE e2.course_id = q.course_id AND e2.active = 1 AND e2.course_role = 'Student' AND e2.assignment_submit_frozen = 0 AND att.quiz_id = q.id ) AS submittedCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment e3 WHERE e3.course_id = q.course_id AND e3.active = 1 AND e3.course_role = 'Student' AND e3.assignment_submit_frozen = 0 ) AS totalStudents, NULL AS assignmentId, q.id AS quizId FROM quiz q INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = q.course_id WHERE q.course_id IN #{id} AND q.state = 'Published' AND q.closes_at >= #{fromUtc} AND q.closes_at <= #{toUtc} ORDER BY q.closes_at ASC, q.id ASC

SELECT 'GroupMembershipChange' AS kind, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, CONCAT(a.action, ' user=', a.target_user_id) AS summary, a.created_at AS occurredAt, NULL AS assignmentId, a.group_set_id AS groupSetId, a.group_id AS groupId, a.target_user_id AS targetUserId FROM group_membership_audit a INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE a.course_id IN #{id} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'LateSubmission' AS kind, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, CONCAT('Late submission: ', a.title) AS summary, v.submitted_at AS occurredAt, a.id AS assignmentId, NULL AS groupSetId, s.group_id AS groupId, s.owner_user_id AS targetUserId FROM assignment_submission s INNER JOIN assignment_submission_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id INNER JOIN assignment a ON a.id = s.assignment_id INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE a.course_id IN #{id} AND s.current_version_id IS NOT NULL AND v.submitted_at > a.due_at AND IFNULL(v.used_grace_buffer, 0) = 0 ORDER BY v.submitted_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
